channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Omri Casspi | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Omri Casspi from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Omri Casspi
item.description:
Connor Letourneau:Kerr on Omri Casspi sitting out tonight to observe Yom Kippur:

“Whatever each person needs to do, obviously we afford them that right.”

Steve Kerr on Omri Casspi, Sep 30, 2017. Source: Twitter @Con_Chron.

item.title: Happy Walters on Omri Casspi
item.description:
CEO and agent at RSG Happy Walters told Sportando,

“Omri told us he wants to sign with us, but hasn't actually signed yet. We are excited to work with him. Casspi is having a good season and we will do some good things with him off the court.”

Happy Walters on Omri Casspi, Nov 30, 2013. Source: Sportando.

item.title: Tony Parker on Omri Casspi
item.description:
Tony Parker:

“It's true, I have spoken with Omri (Casspi) three days ago. He's interested in coming to France and play at ASVEL.We are negotiating right now.”

Tony Parker on Omri Casspi, Aug 23, 2011. Source: Tony Parker Official Site.
